note: Owner 2026-10-06: harmful martial areas hit enemies by default, even when printed text says creatures. Entries override harmful recipients only; benefits and explicit self costs keep their recipients. Keys are typed ability ids (or a forged technique source id). Set recipients to enemies or everyone and explain why. Edits apply to future actions, including saved fights, without rebuilding typed authority. An empty list retains the martial default. Exceptions where physical collateral clearly makes sense belong here rather than in code.

tianxia.talent.sabers.army_line_chopping.reason: Directed saber cuts spare allies; printed creature-wide wording does not require collateral.

TAL_BRUTE_EARTHQUAKE_STOMP.reason: The stomp shakes shared ground and unsecured objects; printed creatures other than you keeps its explicit user exclusion.

TAL_IRON_FIST_THOUSAND_HAND_WAR_BODY.reason: The printed technique directs strikes to any number of creatures chosen by its user, including deliberately chosen allies. Automatic selection remains limited to perceived enemies.
